# User Story Canonical Full Bundle

## 3.1 Bảng tổng hợp User Stories

| Mã US | Story | Trace |
|---|---|---|
| US-AST-001 | As an asset officer, I want to create an asset with a unique code so that inventory audits are reliable. | FR-AST-001, F01, AC-AST-001 |
